proposed_comments.title: Classify Windows shell extensions case-insensitively

confidence.rationale: The classifier compares Windows shell extensions with StringComparison.Ordinal, while Windows file extensions are case-insensitive; the same path is therefore categorized differently based only on casing.

proposed_comments.body:
### Classify Windows shell extensions case-insensitively

**Severity:** `medium`

Windows shell paths commonly contain uppercase extensions such as `APP.EXE,0`. The ordinal comparisons make those inputs fall through to `String`, so the input-kind aggregates do not describe the loader path consistently. Use the same case-insensitive extension rule as the icon loader.

```suggestion
            if (path.EndsWith(".exe", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
                || path.EndsWith(".dll", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
                || path.EndsWith(".lnk", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
```

proposed_comments.title: Record failed icon streams as failures

confidence.rationale: The catch path returns null after an exception, and the caller completes the measurement afterward; without an explicit failure transition this path is counted as an empty result.

proposed_comments.body:
### Record failed icon streams as failures

**Severity:** `medium`

When opening or decoding an icon stream throws, the catch below returns `null` and the later unconditional completion records the load as empty. That hides the failures this diagnostics pass is intended to measure; explicitly transition the measurement to `Failed` from that catch path while preserving the existing null-return behavior.

proposed_comments.title: Announce diagnostics status changes

confidence.rationale: The status TextBlock is updated after Start, Stop, Reset, and Copy, but no live-region setting is present in the changed markup.

proposed_comments.body:
### Announce diagnostics status changes

**Severity:** `low`

This text is the only feedback for starting, stopping, resetting, and copying a recording. Mark it as a polite live region so assistive-technology users receive those state changes without having to navigate back to the control.

```suggestion
                                AutomationProperties.LiveSetting="Polite"
                                MaxWidth="440"
```

proposed_comments.title: Associate the winning in-flight load before publishing it

confidence.rationale: The current code publishes the task through the in-flight dictionary before creating and linking its load measurement, so a fast completion or concurrent request can observe an unassociated winner and distort demand and promotion metrics.

proposed_comments.body:
### Associate the winning in-flight load before publishing it

**Severity:** `medium`

The winning request is inserted into the in-flight dictionary before its load measurement is created and linked. A fast worker or concurrent caller can therefore observe the task before the diagnostic association exists, inflating speculative/promotion counts and undercounting demanded work. Create the measurement and the task together, then publish one immutable in-flight record so every observer sees the same diagnostic state.

proposed_comments.title: Close recording admission atomically at Stop

confidence.rationale: Recording methods check the stop state separately from their counter mutations, while Stop captures the cutoff and report snapshots under a different synchronization boundary; a recorder can pass the check and mutate after the cutoff.

proposed_comments.body:
### Close recording admission atomically at Stop

**Severity:** `high`

The current stop check is separate from the counter and histogram mutations. A recorder can pass `IsStopped`, pause while `Stop()` captures the end timestamp, and then mutate the session while `CreateReport()` is freezing the final totals. Make stopping wait for in-progress recorders, or use one immutable synchronized snapshot, so samples cannot be admitted after the reported cutoff.
